title: Gofer Trace — Workflow Memory Schema
description: Canonical, versioned schema for a captured human workflow. This is the contract between the capture/understanding layer, the knowledge base, and every MCP-connected agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Hermes). Every trace written to disk, loaded into the graph, or served over MCP MUST validate against this schema. Nodes/edges in the knowledge graph are derived directly from these objects (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#graph-model).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema. Consumers MUST check this before parsing. Bump minor for additive fields, major for breaking changes.

workflow_id.description: Stable unique id for the workflow (UUID). Becomes the :Workflow node id in the graph.

title.description: Human-readable name, e.g. 'Deploy staging build and smoke-test'. Populated by the model or the user.

summary.description: One-paragraph natural-language summary of what the user accomplished.

goal.description: The inferred top-level objective of the workflow. Used as the primary retrieval key by agents ('find a workflow that does X').

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the trace was built.

source.description: Provenance of the recording the trace was derived from.

kind.description: How the raw signal was obtained. 'screen_recording' = uploaded video (today's path); 'live_capture' = continuous capture client (roadmap).

media_uri.description: URI of the source video. Local profile: file path or /media/videos/... ; Cloud profile: object-store URL (s3://, https://...).

frame_sampling_sec.description: Interval between sampled frames during understanding (matches video_processing.extract_frames).

capture_host.description: Optional label for the machine/user the capture came from (cloud multi-user).

model.description: Which understanding model produced the analysis. Lets agents weight confidence and lets you diff stub vs. real-VLM traces.

profile.description: Which deployment profile generated this trace.

owner.description: Principal that owns this workflow (cloud multi-user scoping). Set by the backend from the authenticated caller; blank/absent in the single-user local profile.

entities.description: De-duplicated entities referenced across steps (apps, files, URLs, artifacts). Promoted to shared :Entity nodes in the graph so workflows that touch the same tool/file are linked.

steps.description: Ordered workflow steps, one per analyzed segment/frame. Each becomes a :Step node with a NEXT edge to its successor.

artifacts.description: Derived exports attached to this workflow (SOP markdown, agent-memory JSON, segment-launcher HTML).

entity_id.description: Stable id, ideally derived from a normalized key so the same tool/file dedupes across workflows (e.g. sha1('app:vscode')).

type.description: Entity kind. 'credential_ref' is a *reference* only — never store secrets in a trace.

value.description: Optional canonical value (a URL, a file path, a command string).

window_or_context.description: The active app/screen context, e.g. 'Code editor — Python file open'.

observation.description: What the model saw in the frame.

user_action.description: The action the user performed, e.g. 'Running a shell command'.

inferred_intent.description: Why the user did it — the reasoning an agent needs to generalize.

agent_hint.description: Concrete instruction for an agent replaying this step.

action.description: Structured, machine-executable form of user_action. Consumed by planner.py to build BrowserActions. Optional today; required for autonomous execution.

target.description: URL, selector, element description, or command.

value.description: Text to type / payload (empty for non-type actions).

expected_state.description: What should be true after the action — the assertion Qwen visual-verify checks.

entity_refs.description: entity_id values this step touches. Materialized as :Step-[:ACTS_ON]->:Entity edges.

frame_uri.description: URI of the sampled frame image for this step.

embedding_ref.description: Optional id/pointer into the vector index for this step's text embedding (semantic search).

raw_model_output.description: Unparsed model text, kept for auditing/debugging.

uri.description: Where the artifact lives (local path or object-store URL).
